notes: This portable C++ TCK slice publishes one directed interaction under each of two adapter-selected object classes, then requests the subject's publication state through standard MIM interactions. The MIM report must contain one directed-publication report for each object class, identify its matching interaction class, and report two object classes in HLAnumberOfClasses. It uses only official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, the standard MIM, public handle decoders, standard encoding DataElements, and the C++ standard library. Provider package, FOM modules, endpoint, callback configuration, class names, and logical-time implementation come from the adapter. No DDM regions, private headers, provider registry, or vendor-specific API are used.

api_surfaces.signature: virtual void publishObjectClassDirectedInteractions( ObjectClassHandle const & objectClass, InteractionClassHandleSet const & interactionClasses) = 0
